name: U-Joiner
summary: U-Joiners are another belt-routing type added in Demo V8. When combining separate lines, check that each incoming route has already passed through scanning.
version: Demo V8 announcement (September 11, 2026); follow your installed build’s prompts

data.operation: Trace both inputs and the shared output. Test a small flow on each branch so an unnoticed bypass does not feed unscanned products into the selling route.
data.community: The community’s split–scan–join layout is a troubleshooting idea, not a guaranteed capacity upgrade. If the shared output backs up, inspect its destination before adding more inputs.
